title: Zigbee remote as a KNX push button

datapoints._doc: <endpoint>.<property>; endpoint 0 = device identity (zigbeeModel, swBuildId: Basic SWBuildID) and availability (gateway: true/false). zcl.cmd: 'cluster,command,payload' in hex, a command the remote sent to the gateway (gateway zlink.c). batteryPercentageRemaining: the ZCL attribute as reported, 0..254 (nothing for 0xFF); battery: percent, from gateways that convert it themselves.

sources: zigbee-herdsman-converters 26.57.0 (MIT, (c) Koen Kanters), distilled by distill/dump_z2m.cjs (facts only)
zigbee-herdsman-converters 26.57.0 lib/ikea.ts ikeaBattery() and devices/ikea.ts: which models report BatteryPercentageRemaining in percent (model table flags 2 and 4)
ZCL: On/Off cluster commands 0x00-0x02, 0x40-0x42; Level Control commands 0x00-0x07
KNX DPT 3.007 (dimming control: step code 1..7 = 1/2^(code-1) of the range, 0 = break), 5.001, 1.001
open: The gateway binds the remote's On/Off and Level clusters to itself when it links the device; a sleeping remote may miss that and needs a button press while the gateway asks
Long press and release of the IKEA remotes map to move and stop as Zigbee2MQTT reads them; not seen on air yet
Remotes with arrows, scenes or double clicks are not in this class
Which models report the battery in percent is a table from the Zigbee2MQTT definitions; not checked on a device

objects.name: Switch
objects.zigbee: On/Off commands of the remote: on, off, toggle (opposite of KO 5)

objects.name: Dimming
objects.zigbee: Level move -> start brighter/darker (step code 1, 100 %), stop -> stop (0), step -> the step code nearest to the step size (1/2^(code-1) of 254)

objects.name: Battery
objects.zigbee: batteryPercentageRemaining (half percent by ZCL; percent for the models with flag 2, and with flag 4 below the firmware version of the entry, read from swBuildId)

objects.name: SwitchStatus
objects.zigbee: state of the switched load, so toggle sends the opposite

objects.name: Available
objects.text: Zigbee device heard in the last 25 h
objects.zigbee: 0.availability <- gateway (firmware avail.h): a battery device sleeps and is never asked; true from its first frame, false after 25 h without one (also a remote that is only not used); no value after a start of the gateway until its first frame

list.name: InvertSwitch
list.text: Invert the switch telegrams (on button sends 0)
